# XIAORAN MACHINERY — Drilling Rigs & Industrial Equipment Manufacturer

> XIAORAN MACHINERY is a manufacturer and global supplier of exploration drilling rigs, water well drilling rigs, skid steer loaders, spider cranes and aerial work platforms, based in Jining, Shandong, China. The company exports worldwide and supports buyers with written configuration proposals, container packing for shipment and pre-order technical consultation. Sales contact: sales@xiaoranmachinery.cn. Payment, warranty and lead-time specifics are confirmed in written quotations.

## Products
- [Exploration Drilling Rigs](https://www.xiaoranmachinery.cn/products/exploration-drilling-rigs/): wireline core rigs for mineral exploration, 200-1500 m depth (FDX200-FDX600, FD800-FD1500).
- [Water Well Drilling Rigs](https://www.xiaoranmachinery.cn/products/water-well-drilling-rigs/): DTH and mud rotary rigs for household, farm, irrigation and geothermal wells (FY300A-FY500, XZ series).
- [Skid Steer Loaders](https://www.xiaoranmachinery.cn/products/skid-steer-loaders/): wheeled and tracked loaders, 700-1200 kg rated capacity (C1200, V1000, T480, S360).
- [Spider Cranes](https://www.xiaoranmachinery.cn/products/spider-cranes/): compact crawler cranes for indoor and confined-space lifting, 3-12 t (GTJZ04-GTJZ12).
- [Aerial Work Platforms](https://www.xiaoranmachinery.cn/products/aerial-work-platforms/): electric scissor lifts and crawler platforms for indoor and outdoor work at height.
- [Truck-Mounted Drill Rigs](https://www.xiaoranmachinery.cn/products/fyc-truck-mounted/): truck-mounted water well rigs for fast inter-site mobility.
